The status of an asynchronous job

Source: R/jobs.R
soil_job.Rd

Reads a job of the API: a bulk publication of values (soil_publish_values() with transport = "ndjson"), of soil-health scores, a source ingest, a country refresh or an export. The API keeps no list of a user's jobs: the job id returned at submission is the only handle, so keep it.

Usage

soil_job(
  soil = soil_session(),
  job_id,
  detail = c("unified", "publication", "soil_health")
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

job_id

The job id (or the result of a submission). API path parameter {job_id} of GET /jobs/{job_id} (also GET /publication-jobs/{job_id} and GET /soil-health-publication-jobs/{job_id}, by detail), POST /jobs/{job_id}/cancel and POST /source-ingests/{job_id}/validate or /promote.

detail

Which view of the job: "unified", "publication", "soil_health". Client-side; selects the endpoint read, not sent to the API.

Value

A soil_job list with the fields of the view, typed (times as POSIXct, counts as numbers, diagnostics and error as lists).

Details

detail = "unified" reads the common lifecycle of every job (GET /jobs/{job_id}): status (queued, running, validating, promoting, then completed, failed or cancelled), progress_percent, the counts of received, staged, accepted, rejected and published rows, the checksum and size of the uploaded file, the publication receipt (receipt_id), diagnostics and error. "publication" and "soil_health" read the views of a value or a soil-health publication job (GET /publication-jobs/{job_id}, GET /soil-health-publication-jobs/{job_id}), whose diagnostics hold the rejected rows (at most 1,000, diagnostics_truncated) of a failed validation.

Rights: soil:publish.

See also

Other jobs: soil_job_cancel(), soil_job_wait(), soil_refresh_countries()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
job <- soil_job(soil, "0b4e...")
job$status
soil_job(soil, job$job_id, detail = "publication")$diagnostics
} # }
